summary: Comprehensive testing of AgentApex Property ID features completed. All 14 backend API tests passed (100%). Frontend UI tests verified: Property ID system (AX-P-xxxxx format), search-by-id public endpoint, share card with QR code, image management, and critical requirement that contact details are NOT shown in share cards.
critical_code_review_comments: Property ID generation correctly uses AX-{type_code}-{number} format starting at 10001
Type codes correctly mapped: P=Plot/Land, V=Villa, A=Apartment, C=Commercial, F=Farm, H=House
Search-by-id endpoint is correctly public (no auth required)
Share card correctly excludes contact details (phone/email) - critical requirement met
Share card includes QR code linking to Play Store
Image management (reorder, delete, set cover) working correctly
All data-testid attributes properly implemented for testing

test_credentials.otp: Dynamic - shown on screen as 'Demo OTP: XXXXXX'

seed_data_creation: Test properties created and cleaned up during backend tests
context_for_next_testing_agent: Property ID features fully tested. Existing property AX-P-10014 belongs to test user. Search-property page is PUBLIC (no auth). Share card modal uses html-to-image and qrcode.react libraries. Demo guide modal appears on first login - click Skip to dismiss.
